title: Powerful Candlestick [Horizontal Line + Breakout Entry]

entry_short: candle body > 30 pips, price retraces 5 pips above horizontal line drawn at lowest point
exit: no explicit SL/TP; manual close via button or market condition
buildon_idea: add SL/TP levels; test correlation with trend; flat-lot backtest first
novelty_note: simple horizontal line breakout; very common pattern

title: Check Train Quality [EMA Alignment + EMA Distance + RSI Grid Entry]

entry_short: RSI in 51-69 range (neutral) + EMA5 below EMA200 + distance >= 50 pips
exit: trailing stop mode 10 pips, step 1 pip per bar; close on profit accumulation >= 50 USD

novelty_note: quality-score trend filtering adds robustness; grid with stop-loss management
